findings.sectionRef: Approach > Files to Create/Modify, Predicate table
findings.description: deriveNextCommand(state, task) had no repoRoot input, making the parallel-group '/implement-with-ralph --run-only --job <absolute_groupDir>' command underivable since sync-core.mjs emits artifacts.groupDir as repo-relative.
findings.resolution: Added optional options.repoRoot parameter to deriveNextCommand. CLI helper resolves repoRoot via git rev-parse --show-toplevel and forwards it. Predicate table now documents the join: options.repoRoot + '/' + state.artifacts.groupDir.
findings.suggestedFix: Add optional repoRoot arg; CLI helper supplies it.

findings.description: /brainstorm-with-ralph without a name argument cannot resume a specific brainstorm — the skill derives brainstorm_name from $ARGUMENTS.
findings.resolution: Predicate table updated: brainstorming row now emits '/brainstorm-with-ralph <brainstormSlug>' where brainstormSlug is the trailing path segment of state.artifacts.brainstormDir.
findings.suggestedFix: Include brainstorm slug from artifacts.brainstormDir trailing segment.

findings.description: Skill invocation with args may not be supported by the runtime; '/work-on, /triage, /blocker-report invoking skills' is not mechanically verifiable.
findings.resolution: Plan body now documents the explicit skill-name mapping (/plan-with-ralph -> ralph-orchestration:plan-with-ralph etc.) and clarifies that args are forwarded via $ARGUMENTS in the target skill. Acceptance criteria emphasize --dry-run print behavior as the primary observable.
findings.suggestedFix: Document skill-name mapping and rely on --dry-run for verifiability.

findings.description: /blocker-report wording said 'Critical/High findings' but reviewOpenCount in sync-core.mjs counts Medium+ (Critical/High/Medium).
findings.resolution: Updated /blocker-report skill body to say 'open Medium+ review findings' to match MEDIUM_PLUS in sync-core.mjs.

findings.description: The 'shell out via node -e' approach with JSON quoting is fragile on Windows PowerShell; mktemp is not standard.
findings.resolution: Added a dedicated CLI helper at scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs. Skill bodies invoke 'node scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs --task <id>' and parse stdout. One implementation; no per-skill drift.
findings.suggestedFix: CLI wrapper owns JSON marshalling and snapshot I/O.

findings.description: Plan referenced ralph-orchestration v5.30.0 and v5.40.0 but installed version is v5.41.0.
findings.resolution: Updated all version pins to v5.41.0 (predicate top JSDoc comment, version-pin note, 'Read for reference' paths).

findings.description: Other scripts/lib/*.mjs modules have .d.mts declarations; the new module needs one too so Plan 09's MCP server can import directly.
findings.resolution: Added scripts/lib/derive-next-command.d.mts to Files to Create and to acceptance criteria (typecheck must pass).

findings.description: Plan didn't explicitly call out 'browser-safe / Vite-bundlable' as a hard constraint, leaving the door open for the implementer to use node:fs and break the optional UI / Plan 09 integration.
findings.resolution: Added explicit Browser-safe constraint: no node:fs/node:path/node:child_process imports in derive-next-command.mjs.

findings.description: Plan said 'match case-insensitively' but didn't specify exact vs prefix matching; verification text said 'task-id prefix that matches multiple tasks'.
findings.resolution: Clarified: exact match only (case-insensitive), no prefix matching. Verification C still produces a picker for the rare case of an exact match colliding across snapshot.id / jobSlug / groupSlug / brainstorm slug namespaces.

findings.description: /triage didn't distinguish 'snapshot file missing' from 'snapshot present but recommendations empty' — both fell to the wrapper file fallback, which would mask Plan 04 misconfiguration.
findings.resolution: Step 1 now: if snapshot is missing, fall through to wrapper; if snapshot present but recommendations is empty, the empty array is authoritative — show the 'run pnpm sync-ralph-state' message without falling back.

findings.description: Plan didn't clarify how /work-on handles deriveNextCommand returning null for stages OTHER than 'shipped' (artifact-missing case).
findings.resolution: Step 6 now has an explicit branch: null + shipped = grateful exit with mergeCommit; null + any other stage = error with 'cannot derive command... run pnpm sync-ralph-state'.
